verdict.rationale: Gladia documents JSON output (via its CLI, described as machine-readable) and utterance-level results: live final transcripts complete an utterance, and utterance duration is configurable. Speaker diarization implies segmented structure, but nothing in the evidence shows a JSON schema or per-word/per-utterance confidence values. missing for 10: documented confidence scores in the response, documented API response schema with utterance/segment fields, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, results come back as structured JSON with utterances or segments and confidence values, not just a text blob

citations.quote: Flexible output: plain text, JSON, SRT, or VTT to stdout
Pipe-friendly: machine-readable output for scripts and CI
Partial transcripts are provisional; final transcripts complete an utterance.
Configure silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration in Gladia live transcription.
